# Capacitor Agent Skills by Capgo

➡️ Get Instant updates for your App with Capgo

> Formerly `@capgo/capacitor-skills` (and `Cap-go/capacitor-skills`). Links and redirects should continue to work. Agent skills for building, shipping, and maintaining Capacitor apps with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI). Skills are packaged instructions that extend agent capabilities for mobile development. These skills are maintained by [Capgo](https://capgo.app/), the AI-ready platform to build, ship, and maintain Capacitor apps: Capacitor skills and MCP servers for AI coding agents, maintained Capacitor plugins, cloud native iOS/Android builds with App Store and Google Play publishing, live updates with channels and rollback, and release monitoring. **Build Capacitor apps with AI, ship updates instantly.** Browse the catalog at [capgo.app/skills](https://capgo.app/skills/) and the agent setup guide at [capgo.app/agents](https://capgo.app/agents/). ## Initialize & Deploy ```bash npx @capgo/cli@latest init npm run build npx @capgo/cli@latest bundle upload ``` ## Security Scanning with Capsec ```bash # Scan for vulnerabilities npx @capgo/capgo-sec@latest scan # CI mode (fails on high/critical) npx @capgo/capgo-sec@latest scan --ci # Generate HTML report npx @capgo/capgo-sec@latest scan --output html --output-file security.html ``` Capsec detects **63+ security issues** including: - **AI agent tooling**: These [Capacitor skills](https://capgo.app/skills/) plus hosted and local MCP servers for AI coding agents - **Plugins**: [Maintained Capacitor plugins](https://capgo.app/plugins/) for authentication, media, payments, sensors, and more - **Native Builds**: [Cloud iOS and Android builds](https://capgo.app/native-build/) with App Store and Google Play publishing - **Live Updates**: Deploy JS/HTML/CSS instantly without app store review, with channels and rollback - **Release Monitoring**: Track update adoption and release health - **Capsec**: Security scanning for Capacitor apps ## Resources - Capgo: https://capgo.app - Capgo skills catalog: https://capgo.app/skills/ - AI agent setup: https://capgo.app/agents/ - Capgo MCP docs: https://capgo.app/docs/ai/mcp/ - Capsec: https://capacitor-sec.dev - Capacitor: https://capacitorjs.com - Ionic: https://ionicframework.com - Konsta UI: https://konstaui.com - Discord: https://discord.gg/capgo ## Contributing Add new skills by creating a folder in `skills/` with: - `SKILL.md` - Instructions for agents - `metadata.json` - Skill metadata Expose the skill in a Claude Code plugin by creating an empty `plugins//skills//` folder, then copy the canonical files and validate: ```bash bun run sync-skills bun run lint-skills ``` Plugin copies must match `skills/` byte-for-byte; lint fails on drift. Run the skillgrade-backed eval for the skill authoring workflow with an API key: ```bash ENABLE_SKILLGRADE=1 bun run lint-skills-skillgrade ``` ## License MIT

Agent skills for building, shipping, and maintaining Capacitor apps with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI). Skills are packaged instructions that extend agent capabilities for mobile development.

These skills are maintained by Capgo, the AI-ready platform to build, ship, and maintain Capacitor apps: Capacitor skills and MCP servers for AI coding agents, maintained Capacitor plugins, cloud native iOS/Android builds with App Store and Google Play publishing, live updates with channels and rollback, and release monitoring.

Build Capacitor apps with AI, ship updates instantly. Browse the catalog at capgo.app/skills and the agent setup guide at capgo.app/agents.

Lifecycle Coverage

Quick Start with Capgo

1. Create Account

Go to https://capgo.app and sign up.

2. Install CLI


npm install -g @capgo/cli

npx @capgo/cli@latest login

3. Initialize & Deploy


npx @capgo/cli@latest init

npm run build

npx @capgo/cli@latest bundle upload

Security Scanning with Capsec


# Scan for vulnerabilities

npx @capgo/capgo-sec@latest scan



# CI mode (fails on high/critical)

npx @capgo/capgo-sec@latest scan --ci



# Generate HTML report

npx @capgo/capgo-sec@latest scan --output html --output-file security.html

Capsec detects 63+ security issues including:

  • Hardcoded secrets and API keys
  • Insecure storage patterns
  • Network security issues
  • Platform-specific vulnerabilities
  • Authentication weaknesses

Learn more: https://capacitor-sec.dev

About Capgo

Capgo is the AI-ready platform to build, ship, and maintain Capacitor apps:

  • AI agent tooling: These Capacitor skills plus hosted and local MCP servers for AI coding agents
  • Plugins: Maintained Capacitor plugins for authentication, media, payments, sensors, and more
  • Native Builds: Cloud iOS and Android builds with App Store and Google Play publishing
  • Live Updates: Deploy JS/HTML/CSS instantly without app store review, with channels and rollback
  • Release Monitoring: Track update adoption and release health
  • Capsec: Security scanning for Capacitor apps

Contributing

Add new skills by creating a folder in skills/ with:

  • SKILL.md - Instructions for agents
  • metadata.json - Skill metadata

Expose the skill in a Claude Code plugin by creating an empty plugins/<plugin>/skills/<skill>/ folder, then copy the canonical files and validate:


bun run sync-skills

bun run lint-skills

Plugin copies must match skills/ byte-for-byte; lint fails on drift.

Run the skillgrade-backed eval for the skill authoring workflow with an API key:


ENABLE_SKILLGRADE=1 bun run lint-skills-skillgrade
